基于 **Paul Tol "Bright"** 色板（Nature Astronomy/ESA/CERN 标准），7 色 + 4 中性色：

| 语义角色 | 名称 | Hex | 用途 |

| Secondary | Burnt Orange | `#EE7733` | NER 任务、Llama-70B |
| Tertiary | Forest Green | `#228833` | ED 任务、Gemini |
| Negative | Soft Rose | `#CC6677` | IntraSub 错误、High-BCS、Pipeline 失败 |
| Positive | Sky Blue | `#66CCEE` | Low-BCS 条件 |
| Accent | Sand | `#CCBB44` | 关键发现高亮 |
| Reserve | Plum | `#AA3377` | 备用 |

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""BCS range compression across count levels for FewRel RE.

Single-column figure showing how BCS variance narrows at higher counts.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict

DATA = "artifacts/d051_fewrel_n25_s42/eval_results.json"

with open(DATA) as f:
    raw = json.load(f)

by_count = defaultdict(list)
for k, v in raw.items():
    by_count[v["num_types"]].append(v["bcs"])

counts = sorted(by_count.keys())
bcs_data = [by_count[c] for c in counts]

COLORS = {
    4: "#2166AC", 8: "#4393C3", 16: "#92C5DE",
    32: "#F4A582", 40: "#D6604D", 64: "#B2182B", 80: "#67001F",
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.4))

positions = list(range(len(counts)))
bp = ax.boxplot(
    bcs_data, positions=positions, widths=0.5,
    patch_artist=True, showfliers=False,
    medianprops=dict(color="white", lw=1.2),
    whiskerprops=dict(color="#555555", lw=0.8),
    capprops=dict(color="#555555", lw=0.8),
)
for i, (patch, count) in enumerate(zip(bp["boxes"], counts)):
    patch.set_facecolor(COLORS[count])
    patch.set_edgecolor("#333333")
    patch.set_linewidth(0.6)
    patch.set_alpha(0.75)
    jitter = np.random.default_rng(42).uniform(-0.15, 0.15, len(bcs_data[i]))
    ax.scatter(
        np.full(len(bcs_data[i]), positions[i]) + jitter,
        bcs_data[i],
        c=COLORS[count], s=6, alpha=0.45, edgecolors="none", zorder=3,
    )

ranges = [max(d) - min(d) for d in bcs_data]
for i, (pos, rng) in enumerate(zip(positions, ranges)):
    if counts[i] in [4, 16, 64]:
        ax.text(pos, max(bcs_data[i]) + 0.012, f"$\\Delta$={rng:.2f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=5.5, color="#555555")

ax.set_xticks(positions)
ax.set_xticklabels([str(c) for c in counts], fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("Number of schema types ($k$)", fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("Batch Confusability Score", fontsize=8)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)
for spine in ["top", "right"]:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.4)
out = "figures/paper/fig_bcs_scatter.pdf"
plt.savefig(out, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
print(f"Saved to {out}")
plt.close()

For practitioners, reducing candidate types is the primary lever for NER; for RE, pre-computing SCS/BCS can flag high-risk schemas before deployment. Naive mitigations (renaming, few-shot) do not close the gap (Appendices~\ref{app:renaming},~\ref{sec:appendix_fewshot_bcs}). Direct confirmation of the representational mechanism via probing remains future work.

Per-type analysis on MAVEN reveals an anomalous \emph{positive} BCS--F1 correlation ($\rho = +0.184\text{--}0.208$, $p < 0.03$): FrameNet-derived types cluster tightly \citep{cai-isotropy-clusters-2021}, conflating confusability with centrality. Controlling for log frequency and degree centrality, the correlation vanishes ($p > 0.2$; Appendix~\ref{sec:appendix_residualized_bcs}), though the pairwise SCS signal remains intact ($r = 0.129$, $p < 0.001$). Few-NERD's cross-domain schema shows the expected negative direction ($\rho = -0.293$, $p = 0.02$); mean BCS is reliable only for cross-domain schemas.

27	A natural intervention is to partition the schema so confusable types never co-occur (Figure~\ref{fig:sdgd_pipeline}). We tested Schema-DAG-Guided Decomposition (SDGD), which applies greedy graph coloring on the SCS graph to assign types to low-confusability batches. While oracle routing recovers accuracy (0.724 vs.\ 0.504 single-pass; Table~\ref{tab:routing_strategies}), all practical routing strategies fall below the single-pass baseline, and NER decomposition amplifies false positives (F1: 0.445$\to$0.251). Merge amplification is the structural bottleneck: union merge doubles false positives (precision: 0.56$\to$0.21) while voting merge sacrifices recall. Confusability-aware batch composition avoids routing entirely and achieves higher accuracy under oracle assignment (Appendix~\ref{sec:appendix_batch_composition}). Full protocol in Appendix~\ref{sec:appendix_sdgd}.
